name: code-modernization
description: Guided modernization for any legacy codebase: an assessment, a structure map, the business rules mined from the code, a plan a person approves, then an uplift, a rewrite or a rebuild with independent proof that the new code behaves like the old. Includes security hardening, a one-page HTML report and eight specialist subagents.
author: Anthropic (original Claude Code plugin), ported to MiniMax Code
exampleQueries: Use code-modernization:modernize to work out what this legacy system does and what to do with it.
Use code-modernization:modernize-extract-rules to mine the business rules out of this codebase.
Use code-modernization:modernize-verify to prove that the rewritten module behaves like the old one.
Use code-modernization:modernize-harden to scan the legacy system for security problems.
